Rand has saved Mat's life at least three times. He brought him back to life in Rhuidean, he brought him back when he killed Rahvin and he's kinda saved his life when he helped to take him to Tar Valon to finally have him separated from the curse of the dagger from Shadar Logoth. I think, though that the connection between Mat and the Horn of Valere was cut by his death in Rhuidean, not with his revoked death in Caemlyn.
